notablePrerequisites:
You have a nonartifact land in hand that enters untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
 You control a nontoken nonartifact land.
description:
Play a nonartifact land.
Tireless Tracker, Kodama, and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, if the land enters the battlefield untapped, activate the nonartifact land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning another nonartifact land to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a Clue token.
The Clue enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama, putting a nonartifact land onto the battlefield from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Tireless Tracker and Cloudstone Curio.
Repeat from step 4.
